references.text: Moses feared that the people would stone him, the same threat as against Caleb and Joshua here
The glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud before the whole congregation of Israel
The glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle, as it appears here at the tent of meeting
The glory of the Lord appeared to the whole congregation during a similar rebellion situation
The glory of the Lord was revealed again at the tent of meeting during Korah's rebellion
The glory of the Lord appeared to Moses and Aaron at the tent of meeting
The glory of the Lord appeared to all the people
Threat of stoning against a leader in Israel, similar situation with David
The pillar of cloud stood at the entrance of the tent, and the Lord spoke with Moses while the people watched
Stephen was stoned by the people, a parallel to the threat of stoning here
